Lead-in task 1b relevant wichtig; relevant John Lennon’s thoughts are still relevant nowadays. chapter map fitting in dazugehören Julia found fitting in with her new classmates hard. chapter map personal relations persönliche Beziehungen The personal relations between the teachers and students are quite positive. chapter map individuality Individualität; Einzigartigkeit He expresses his individuality through his clothes. Words in Context: Finding my own path l. 3 take sb./sth. for granted jdn./etw. als selbstverständlich ansehen Rather than showing appreciation for the fact that I do lots of overtime, my boss just takes it for granted. l. 5 develop your character seinen Charakter / seine Persönlichkeit entwickeln Trying new things that force you to leave your comfort zone can help to develop your character. l. 9 sense of self Selbstempfinden; Selbstwahrnehmung People with a strong sense of self are less likely to be influenced by social media. l. 11 find one’s place in society seinen Platz in der Gesellschaft finden Her parents moved to the ‘Mother Country’ from the Caribbean but struggled to find their place in society. l. 13 develop a sense of identity ein Identitätsbewusstsein entwickeln The programme is intended to help young people use goals and values to develop a healthy sense of identity. l. 14 conform to social norms sich an gesellschaftliche Normen anpassen Failing to conform to social norms could be a sign of rebellion, but also of certain personality disorders. l. 15 stand out from the crowd sich von der Masse abheben Improve your chances of success at interviews by emphasizing what makes you stand out from the crowd. l. 19 shape your own destiny sein Schicksal selbst bestimmen She decided to shape her own destiny rather than just wait for things to happen. l. 20 equality of opportunity Chancengleichheit Legislation to ensure equality of opportunity for people from ethnic minorities has been enacted. l. 21 address social inequalities soziale Ungleichheiten in Angriff nehmen The government set up the program to monitor and address social inequalities.

Text 9: My journey into the world of men’s beauty task 2 persuade sb. to do sth. jdn. überreden etw. zu tun The convenience of E-bikes will persuade more people to leave their cars at home. task 2 impress sb. jdn. beeindrucken The footballer impressed the crowd with her ball skills. task 2 refuse to do sth. sich weigern etw. zu tun Although they were losing, the team refused to give up. task 2 offer an opportunity for sb. to do sth. jdm. eine Gelegenheit bieten etw. zu tun Social media offers an opportunity for people to connect. task 2 promote sth. für etw. werben Brands promote their products on social media.
